end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals; some examples were right, but this still needs checking next time.
Practised explaining “unity in diversity” and how shared activities can connect people; this still needs checking next time.
Riya first said diversity causes division, then noticed shared family time and exchanging sweets across different festivals; the mix-up was corrected after the last seen example.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised regional differences in language, food, dress and festivals with Riya. Riya gave examples such as Hindi, idli and kurta-pyjama, and later noticed that different festivals can share family time and exchanging sweets; the idea that diversity always causes conflict was corrected in the final example, though it needs more practice. At home, ask Riya to make a two-column list of differences and shared features for two festivals, foods or languages.
